components.contract_summary: Demographic, epidemiology, tobacco, clinical intervention, burden, economic, and resource logic are held in one model JSON.
components.label: Asthma monolith

intended_use: The asthma model runs asthma epidemiology, selected clinical interventions, tobacco risk-factor effects, and downstream burden, resource, and economic event streams.
limits: The modular composition is currently rejoined into one executable model for the Rust runtime. The run certificate records what was run; it does not encode future comparison intent.
summary: This card describes the current asthma model structure used for the CR1 run.
title: Asthma Monolith
